strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Raideen destroyed.
What... what is this place? Raideen...?
Answer me, Raideen! This empty space...
Weren't you trying to show me something!?
No good... Maybe I should've gone with Umon to join everyone...
Th-these things are... I knew it!
I see, that's it, isn't it, Raideen! This spot is...!
They keep pouring in...! Raideen, how long can we hold out...!?
Hm! An enemy I've never seen...! But... Raideen's reacting...!
Is this one with them too!?
You can still go on, right, Raideen? ...Now let's see what you really are!
Raaaaai!
It's around here. The spot Akira headed for...
He said there was something he just had to check...
I wonder if he found what he was looking for? Oh, look there!
Is it around here? The spot Raideen headed for?
He said there was something he just had to confirm, so he split off
from Daisuke and the others... Ah!
That robot over there! Isn't that it!?
A Federation battleship...! This is Akira Hibiki, in Raideen!
You're with Londo Bell, right!?
That's right. We came to pick you up. ...Are you all right!?
Raideen led me here,
but then these things attacked me...
Understood. Captain, we're heading out.
But what is this place, anyway? And those enemies... it's that bunch again!
...This area... Captain, launching.
Are you... all right...?
Excellen...?
What's with that lady? Her face was white as a sheet.
Yeah... She doesn't seem to be feeling well.
It's always when those bony guys or plant guys show up, right?
What are you all doing!? Launch!
...What are you...!?
...This... place...
...!! I knew it...! Why do you talk so only I can hear you!?
Whoa, whoa, Excellen! What are you even talking about!?
...What's gotten into her?
What's wrong!? Jun, did you hear anything?
Nothing at all. What is she talking about?
A voice!? Same as Kyosuke...!? Who are you!?
Excellen, Hibiki, focus on the battle for now. We'll talk later!
Y-yes, sir!
Hm!? Enemy reinforcements!?
Ugh... What is this feeling...?
What... is this unpleasant sensation...
How do I put it... it feels nasty...
Ugh... I feel kinda sick.
...This is different from before...
That one... Brother, that one's dangerous...!
Maria!? Everyone else too... What is that enemy?
This pressure... No, should I even call it pressure?
This alien sensation...
Hey, hey, you guys okay? We're about to fight here.
That one that just appeared... is it the source of this feeling...?
Everyone, are you okay?
Something like... a sickening... atmosphere?
Y-yeah... it's not so bad I can't move my mobile suit...
I just feel a little sick.
Then we're fine. Let's hurry up and take care of these guys!
If there's no problem, fine... but either way, stay sharp!
There's no telling what might happen!
What is this place? And weird guys we've never seen showing up...
Well, it all worked out. We met up with Hibiki, too.
Exactly. You're Akira Hibiki, right? I've heard about you.
I'm Bright Noa of Londo Bell.
Pleased to meet you. Oh, and Umon...
I'm sorry for running off on my own like that...
Don't worry about it. The Elshank is safe, too.
Pleased to meet you. Oh, what about Umon and the others...
The Elshank ran aground, apparently. They'll join us later.
Yo, Akira. You look well.
Akira, it's been a while.
We haven't seen Raideen since we split up on Earth.
Good to have you with us again.
But why'd you go wandering off alone the moment we got to space?
Yeah. Coming out here all alone, you must've had a good reason, right?
...Raideen... told me to come here.
Huh? What do you mean?
Um... Akira Hibiki, do you have a minute?
Ah, you're... Right, I wanted to talk to you too. About that mystery enemy...
Kyosuke said something about voices, too. You're Excellen, right?
What's your relationship with him?
Relationship? Come on, don't ask something so obvious, Akira.
Koji! Be quiet!
Aren't they dating?
I don't think that's what Akira's getting at, is it?
He's...
(So it is... that accident during the One Year War...)
Captain... Captain, what's wrong?
...Ah, no, it's nothing, Captain.
Hibiki, there seems to be a lot going on, but we're in mid-operation.
Understood. Excellen, we'll talk later.
...Sure.
For now, we'll have to be happy that we've beefed up our forces.
Right. ...This should improve our chances of stopping the colony.
Not chances. We WILL stop this colony drop, Operation Stardust!
All units, return to the ship.
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
